The '''1983 [[Eliteserien|1. divisjon]]''' was the 39th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]].

==Overview==
22 games were played with 2 points given for wins and 1 for draws. Number eleven and twelve were relegated. The winners of the two groups of the [[1. divisjon|2. divisjon]] were promoted, as well as the winner of a series of play-off matches between number ten in the 1. divisjon and the two second-placed teams in the two groups of the 2. divisjon. 

[[Vålerenga Fotball|Vålerengen]] won the championship, their third title.

==Relegation play-offs==
The qualification play-off matches were contested between Brann (10th in the 1. divisjon), [[IF Pors|Pors]] (2nd in the 2. divisjon - Group A), and [[Strindheim IL|Strindheim]] (2nd in the 2. divisjon - Group B). Strindheim won and were promoted to the [[1984 Norwegian First Division|1. divisjon]].
